meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.orientation: You enter from the kitchen (west wall) facing east. Left = north end (bath wall), right = south end (kitchen external wall).
meta.note: Product sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm against the exact models before carpentry is fabricated.

interior.note: Wall-face to wall-face, assuming 150 mm internal / 250 mm external walls: 1300 W x 2320 L. Verify on site.

laundry_counter.note: Folding top over washer + dryer, wall to wall. Needs ledger supports on the 3 walls.

front_loaders.name: Washer
front_loaders.note: Front-load washer ~600 W x 600 D x 850 H

front_loaders.name: Dryer
front_loaders.note: Front-load heat-pump (ventless) dryer ~600 W x 600 D x 850 H

tall_cabinet.note: Front faces north. Per owner's sketch, seen from the yard: LEFT column (east, next to sink) = robot bay at floor, then detergent bottles + plastic-bag basket, then pegs / mesh bags; RIGHT column (west) = Dyson niche with laundry-pods basket on top. Full-width hanger rod at 1900 (hangers only), top shelf for overstock. Doors not drawn so the inside is visible.

robot_vacuum.note: Self-emptying / self-washing dock with water hookup kit: water inlet point + floor drain behind the dock.

stick_vacuum.note: Dyson cordless on floor dock, ~250 W x 1260 H; charging socket inside niche.

utility_sink.note: Hand-wash laundry / shoe sink: 560 W unit, stainless undermount basin 460 x 420 x 300 deep (fits a shoe).

ceiling_rack.name: Steigen Solar Mini
ceiling_rack.note: Body 1100 x 500 mm; install clearance 1100 x 600 body / up to 1800 extended; product max length 1650 (drawn). Centred over the walkway + folding counter so it never lowers onto the tall cabinet.

accessories.name: Hangers
accessories.note: Stored on the rod for easy grab

ipad_platform.note: Floating plank on concealed wall brackets along the back of the folding counter: full length (1300) x 160 deep x 25 thick, top at 1000 mm from the floor (~55 mm gap above the counter). Holds the iPad + mini cactus; ~520 of the 680 counter depth stays clear for folding.
